name: JSON Viewer - Advanced Formatter
description: Powerful JSON formatter & visualizer with tree, raw & diagram views. Customizable themes, fonts & auto-detection for developers
author: Yusuf Turek

permissions_justification.activeTab: Needed to detect and format JSON content in the currently active tab without requiring persistent access to all tabs.
permissions_justification.storage: Required to save user preferences like theme, font settings, and view mode selection.
permissions_justification.scripting: Needed to inject scripts that identify and format JSON content within web pages.

host_permissions_justification: All URLs access is required for automatic JSON detection on any website the user visits.
purpose: This extension has a single purpose: to format and visualize JSON data to help developers and technical users understand JSON structures more easily.
